$comment: The enforced icon allowlist: hadoku icon name -> lucide-static slug.
This file is the ONLY hand-edited half of the registry. `pnpm run generate:icons`
reads it, pulls the artwork out of lucide-static, and writes registry.generated.ts.
Adding an icon = add a line here + regenerate. A slug that lucide does not have
fails the generator loudly rather than emitting a hole.
Names describe the PICTOGRAPH, not the app that uses it, so a category reorg in
hadoku_site never renames an icon. Every name below is backed by at least one real
usage found in the 2026-08-12 ecosystem emoji scan (39 repos, 12 months of commits).
$comment_apps: Found rendered in child-app source: task, tenhands, conjure, meet, pygmalion, dataplatform, watchpart2, aggregator, trader, contact-ui.
$comment_chrome: UI chrome already in use via lucide-react in hadoku-pygmalion's local icons.tsx, so that file can retire in favour of this registry.
